name: Drica Moraes
bio: Adriana Moraes Rêgo Reis (Rio de Janeiro, July 29, 1969) is a Brazilian actress. She began her career on the Tablado stage and later became known for her roles as determined and complex women on television and cinema. Moraes is the winner of several awards, including a Grande Otelo, an APCA, two Mambembes and a Brazil Quality Award, in addition to being nominated for four Guarani Awards and three Shell Awards.
